process_lessons.lesson: Fingerprint exact loaded engine; CLI provenance can disagree with ctypes runtime.
Representation ownership localized +444 of +446 B before broad instrumentation.
After proving a version downgrade works, still test whether the newer engine can explicitly emulate inherited semantics before accepting broader decoder debt.
Keep semantic identity and performance rehabilitation separate.
Installed dependency closure is necessary but not sufficient.
